title: 6.3 Logarithms and Logarithmic Functions

icans: I can rewrite logarithmic and exponential equations.
I can evaluate logarithms, with and without a calculator.
I can find inverses and graph logarithmic functions.

vocab: log_b y = x __________ bˣ = y (b > 0, b ≠ 1): the exponent you put on b to get y
f(x) = log_b x, the inverse of g(x) = bˣ; domain x > 0, ____________ x = 0

blocks.p: Find each missing exponent. Then write the equation as a logarithm: “log base __ of __ = __.”
Can any exponent on 2 give 0 or a negative number? ______________________________

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Definition of a logarithm: logb y = x means _______________. A logarithm is an _______________.

blocks.stem: a.  Rewrite log₃ 81 = 4 in exponential form.        b.  Rewrite 6⁻¹ = 1/6 in logarithmic form.

notes: Special logarithms: logb 1 = ______ logb b = ______ log x means log base ______ ln x means log base ______
